answer: Audits are published in zephyr, queued in inlet, and wharf publishes the wait time. A farm of 71 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 71 identities per epoch. A farm of 752 identities would post 3477 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
